summary: Cal Fire lookout on Smith Mountain, Los Padres NF, Monterey County: 1930 station, 1944 timber tower, 1976 cab on block tower; NHLR-registered 2010.

facts.design: 10-foot block tower with 13 by 13 foot CL-100 metal cab, moved there in 1976
facts.agency: Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (Cal Fire)

events.note: State selects Smith Mountain as a lookout station site
NHLR says the first lookout was built in 1930; a July 1930 article describes the new state station and its telephone line
60-foot tower announced in February 1931; April 1931 report says work will shortly start
10-foot timber tower with cab replaces the first lookout
A balloon reported from the San Joaquin Valley is sighted from the station and turns out to be the planet Venus
The NHLR Built field gives 1964; the register's own description does not match this date
CL-100 cab moved from Black Mountain and placed on a 10-foot block tower by CalFire
Registered June 19, 2010 as US 884, CA 94; nominated by Brad Eells

corrections.why: 18.3 m is 60 feet, the height of the tower announced in February 1931. The Register gives no height and describes a 10-foot block tower with a cab; no source read gives 18.3 m for the standing structure.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register's Built field says 1964, but the same page says the first lookout was built in 1930 and replaced in 1944. A July 1930 article describes the new state station, which supports 1930. The sources read do not explain the 1964 date.

The Register description says the CL-100 cab was moved onto the block tower in 1976, while a photo caption credits the 1944 tower with a BC-301 cab. The sources do not reconcile these; the story reports both.

The Register dates the first lookout to 1930. The 1931 newspaper extracts describe a 60-foot tower still being planned and about to start. The sources do not say which structure the 1930 date refers to.

notes_for_editor: Access, staffing and current condition are not in any source read; the access key is omitted rather than guessed. The FFLA Southern California list (firelookouthost.org/southern-california) has a Smith Mtn row, but its columns are jumbled in the cache, so it is not cited. The 1964 Built field and the 1944 BC-301 caption conflict with the description; the story flags both. Height 18.3 m in the record matches the 1931 60-foot tower plan, so it is proposed for removal. The status key was removed: no source read gives the current condition, and the story says so. Pending a Cal Fire San Benito-Monterey Unit or Los Padres NF source for access and status. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the story's 'best-known item' claim was removed as unsupported.
